sentences.en: The page of future history will tell how Britain planted, nourished, and for two centuries preserved a second British Empire.

sentences.en: How strengthened by her sons, she rose to such a pitch of power that this little island proved too mighty for the greatest efforts of the greatest nations.

sentences.en: Within the space of 20 years, the world beheld her arms triumphant in every quarter of the globe.

sentences.en: Her fleet displayed victorious banners, her sails were spread, and conquest graced the canvas.

sentences.en: Historic truth must likewise relate.

sentences.en: Within the same little space of time, her Britain fell to half her greatness.
sentences.zh: 在同样短的时间内，大不列颠却跌落了一半的宏伟。

sentences.en: How strangely lost, by misjudging ministers, by rash-advised councils, our gracious sovereign George III saw more than half his empire crumble beneath his sceptre.
sentences.zh: 由于昏庸的大臣和鲁莽的谋士，我们的仁慈君主乔治三世眼睁睁看着他半数以上的帝国在权杖下崩解，这实在令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: America, late the strength, now the foe to Britain.
sentences.zh: 美洲，曾经是大不列颠的力量之源，如今却成了敌人。

sentences.en: Dismembered, torn, I fear, forever lost to England, whence she sprung.
sentences.zh: 支离破碎，四分五裂，我担心，这个她发源的英国已然永远失去了它。

sentences.zh: 所以汤姆，那是1775年11月曼彻斯特公爵在英国上议院关于美国独立战争中在殖民地使用外国军队的一次辩论中的发言。

sentences.zh: 所以对我们英国人来说，有趣的是，我们对此其实并不太了解，对吧？

sentences.zh: 它在美国人的意识中占据着如此巨大的分量，但在英国却并未被教授。

sentences.en: And heroic defeats in which ultimately we prevail.

sentences.en: Maybe, maybe, maybe you're right.
sentences.zh: 也许，也许，也许你是对的。

sentences.en: So, you know, in the Duke of Manchester's comment there, that I fear forever lost to England.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，正如曼彻斯特公爵刚才的评论所说，我担心永远失去了英国。

sentences.en: Although the funny, as we said, the funny thing is that our British listeners probably won't have strong opinions because they don't really know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 尽管有趣的是，正如我们所说，英国听众可能不会有什么强烈的看法，因为他们对它一无所知。

sentences.zh: 所以亚当，这是一个庞大的主题，嗯，一个悲剧的主题，有人可能会这么说，也许我们应该从

sentences.zh: 殖民地看起来是什么样的？

sentences.zh: 它们看起来非常繁荣、非常自信、人口非常稠密。

sentences.zh: 英国皇家海军计算过，殖民地居民的身价比英格兰居民高出两英寸。

sentences.en: And that tells you a lot, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 这说明了很多问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: In the 1750s and 1760s, about one and a half million people lived in the
sentences.zh: 在18世纪50年代和60年代，大约有150万人生活在

sentences.zh: 殖民地，即后来起义的13个殖民地。

sentences.en: And they were used to self-government in practice.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在实践中习惯了自治。

sentences.en: And this is obviously really important in terms of the story that we're going to tell.
sentences.zh: 这在我们即将讲述的故事中显然非常重要。

sentences.en: They had different kinds of charters, some were royal colonies, some were established in different ways.
sentences.zh: 他们有不同种类的特许状，有些是皇家殖民地，有些是以不同方式建立的。

sentences.en: But in one way or another, they all had forms of representative government.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，他们都拥有某种形式的代议制政府。

sentences.en: And because property was much more easily accessible, they all had property qualifications, a property franchise, just as was the case in Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 由于财产更容易获得，他们都有财产资格限制，即财产选举权，就像大不列颠的情况一样。

sentences.en: But in practice, this meant that a much wider, much wider number of
sentences.zh: 但在实践中，这意味着有更多、

sentences.en: people could vote and participate in government.
sentences.zh: 多得多的人能够投票并参与政府管理。

sentences.en: In New England, they had this very strongly entrenched tradition of town meetings.
sentences.zh: 在新英格兰，他们拥有根深蒂固的镇民大会传统。

sentences.en: And so there was this really active participation in the formulation of policy and the running of local affairs.
sentences.zh: 因此，在政策制定和地方事务管理方面有着非常积极的参与。

sentences.en: And so London seemed a very long way away.
sentences.zh: 所以伦敦显得非常遥远。

sentences.en: In another sense,
sentences.zh: 从另一个意义上说，

sentences.en: London seemed closer perhaps than the other colonies.
sentences.zh: 伦敦或许比其他殖民地显得更近一些。

sentences.en: It was easier to get from, much easier to get from
sentences.zh: 从……出发更容易，从

sentences.en: Boston to London than it was from Boston to Charlestown in South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 波士顿到伦敦要比从波士顿到南卡罗来纳州的查尔斯顿容易得多。

sentences.en: There was a post road from
sentences.zh: 有一条邮政公路从

sentences.en: Boston to New York, but it was a trial to get from Boston to Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 波士顿通往纽约，但从波士顿到费城却是一场考验。

sentences.en: So there wasn't much
sentences.zh: 因此，殖民地之间并没有太多的

sentences.en: intercolonial interaction.
sentences.zh: 互动。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, they were separate from the mother country in terms of practical governance.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，就实际治理而言，它们与母国是分离的。

sentences.en: That didn't mean they felt separate, though.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他们觉得自己是分开的。

sentences.en: They were patriotic Englishmen.
sentences.zh: 他们是爱国的英国人。

sentences.en: And they said that repeatedly right up until the breach in 1776.
sentences.zh: 他们一直这样反复重申，直到1776年决裂为止。

sentences.zh: 那么亚当，英国在新大陆的某种政府存在是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, it's very slight, Tom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常微弱，汤姆。

sentences.en: But the Seven Years' War, which I know you've also done a podcast about,
sentences.zh: 但是七年战争——我知道你也做过一期关于它的播客，

sentences.en: haven't you?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So I don't know whether we want to get into that now.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道我们现在是否想深入探讨这个。

sentences.en: But the Seven Years' War really changed the dynamic because then there was a British military presence.
sentences.zh: 但七年战争真正改变了态势，因为从那时起有了英国的军事存在。

sentences.en: There was a distant
sentences.zh: 有了来自

sentences.en: London supervision of the colonies.
sentences.zh: 伦敦对殖民地的遥控监督。

sentences.en: There was a secretary of state for America.
sentences.zh: 有了美洲事务国务大臣。

sentences.en: And there was a complex system of navigation laws, the mercantilist system, which attempted to restrict colonial trade, although it wasn't very good at doing so.
sentences.zh: 并且有一套复杂的航海法体系，即重商主义体系，它试图限制殖民地贸易，尽管它在这方面做得并不好。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly leaky system.
sentences.zh: 这是一个漏洞百出的系统。

sentences.en: So there was a broad framework of law within the context of Britain and the allegiance to the British royal family, which
sentences.zh: 因此，在英国的框架和对英国皇室的效忠这一背景下，存在着广泛的法律框架，

sentences.en: Englishmen on the other side of the Atlantic always felt.
sentences.zh: 大西洋彼岸的英国人一直能感受到这一点。

sentences.en: But the Seven Years' War was the moment when presence was felt on the ground, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，七年战争是这种存在真正在实地显现的时刻。

sentences.en: And so the Seven Years' War in America is generally known as the French and Indian War.
sentences.zh: 所以七年战争在美洲通常被称为法国与印第安人战争。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's right, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And that kind of sums up what the stakes are for Britain and for the 13 colonies in North America, because they are faced with two foes.
sentences.zh: 这某种程度上总结了英国和北美13个殖民地面临的利害关系，因为他们面临着两个敌人。

sentences.en: They're faced with the French, which have a massive imperial presence in Canada and kind of reaching into the centre of North America.
sentences.zh: 他们面临着法国人，法国在加拿大拥有庞大的帝国势力，并一直延伸到北美中部。

sentences.en: And of course, they have the Indians, as they were called, the Native Americans, who are also very, very kind of sizable confederations at this point.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们还有所谓的印第安人，即美洲原住民，此时他们的部落联盟也相当庞大。

sentences.en: And yet the British emerge victorious from that war.
sentences.zh: 然而，英国人从那场战争中取得了胜利。

sentences.en: The French shall basically expelled from the New World.
sentences.zh: 法国人基本上被驱逐出了新大陆。

sentences.en: And the corollary of that is that there is a huge military presence now in America.
sentences.zh: 其随之而来的结果是，如今在美洲有了庞大的军事存在。

sentences.en: And that presumably is something that hadn't been the case prior to the
sentences.zh: 据推测，这在

sentences.en: Seven Years' War.
sentences.zh: 七年战争之前是不存在的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.zh: 实际上，贯穿所有这些关于美国

sentences.en: It's a story about British relations with Europe in one sense.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这是一个关于英国与欧洲关系的故事。

sentences.en: And, you know, you ask about British presence in America.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你问到英国在美洲的存在。

sentences.en: If you're a British
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个身处白厅的英国

sentences.en: administrator in Whitehall, thinking about your colonies in the middle of the 18th century,
sentences.zh: 行政官员，在18世纪中期考虑你的殖民地时，

sentences.en: you're not really worried about what's going to happen in the port cities in Boston and Philadelphia before the 1860s.

sentences.en: What you're worried about, as you say, Tom, is the French presence in the interior

sentences.zh: 以及欧洲的力量平衡问题，以及欧洲在北美的存在将如何影响这一点。

sentences.zh: 亚当，难道不是吗，当人们谈论殖民地时，他们其实是在谈论——

sentences.en: Is that too strong to describe the
sentences.zh: 用这个词来形容

sentences.zh: 13个殖民地是否过分了？

sentences.zh: 但完全正确的是，

sentences.en: And we'll get onto this later.

sentences.zh: 失去糖岛（牙买加、巴巴多斯、安提瓜）这一更令人担忧的前景，他们通过与法国和西班牙进行海战最终避免了这一点。

sentences.zh: 远征，不是吗？由布拉多克将军率领，旨在进攻并夺取
